days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 130 ? you logged push day this week, finally. 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Reps are in the range but all three sets hit RPE 8, which means you're working hard but not efficiently enough yet to earn 135. Need 10/10/10 at RPE ? 7 to move up. Touch the chest, pause a half-beat, drive through the heels. Work on breathing ? big inhale before you unrack, stay braced through the whole set. The weight is right, the reps need to climb.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? last week you went 8/10/10. Set 1 only got 8 reps, sets 2 and 3 were solid. Need all three sets at 10 reps to earn 50. The reps are there by set 2 ? figure out what's different in your setup on set 1. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees off the torso, control the negative all the way down. Don't rush into set 1 ? take the full 90 seconds of rest after bench before you pick up the dumbbells.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? last week 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/9. Reps are maxed out, but set 3 hit RPE 9 which is too expensive. Need all three sets at RPE ? 7 to earn 35. The fix is pacing ? don't grind set 1 and 2 harder than you need to. Press straight up, full lockout, don't lean back. If you can dial the effort down to a 7 on sets 1 and 2, set 3 follows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: UP to 15 ? last week you went 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 at 15 lbs. Wait ? you logged 15 lbs this week, not 12. You grabbed the heavier pair and hit all three sets at 10 reps. That earns the bump: 15 is now the working weight going forward. Need 12/12/12 at RPE ? 7 to earn 20. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbow, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? replacing dips this week. Dips were a disaster last week: 5/4/4 at RPE 10/10/10. That's a movement you're not ready to load at bodyweight for working sets yet ? we'll revisit them but not right now. Flyes give the chest a different stimulus, focusing on the stretch and squeeze rather than pressing. Start at 20 lbs. Slight bend in the elbows, lower in a wide arc until you feel the stretch across the chest, bring them back up and squeeze at the top. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log what you actually used.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: Staying at 40 ? last week 12/12/10 at RPE 8/8/9. Sets 1 and 2 were clean, set 3 dropped 2 reps and cost you an RPE 9. Need 12/12/12 at RPE ? 8 to earn 45. Elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom for full extension, control the return. Don't let set 3 become a grind ? if you feel yourself losing the lockout, slow down the tempo.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 185 ? last week was your best deadlift session in a while: 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7. That's exactly what we've been waiting for. You earned the bump ? but we're holding at 185 one more week to confirm it wasn't a one-off. Hit 10/10/10 at RPE ? 7 again this week and you get 195 next session, no questions asked. Lats tight, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. Stay patient.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? last week 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Reps are in the range but not at the top, and RPE is sitting at 8 across the board. Need 10/10/10 at RPE ? 7 to earn 60. Pull to the hip, full second squeeze at the top, slow the negative. If your grip is failing before your back does, strap up ? don't let grip be the limiter here. Log each side.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 100 ? last week 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/9. Sets 1 and 2 were perfect. Set 3 spiked to RPE 9 which kills the progression. Need all three sets at RPE ? 8 to earn 110. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom. Set 3 is where you're leaning back and turning it into a row ? catch that, stay upright, and let the lats do the work.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: UP to 65 ? last week 15/15/15 at RPE 6/6/7. All three sets clean, all at the top of the range, RPE never cracked 7. That's a clear earn. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish. Need 15/15/15 at RPE ? 7 to earn 70. Don't let the move get sloppy just because the weight feels manageable.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? last week 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. Reps are maxed out but RPE is sitting at 8 across all three sets. Need all three at RPE ? 7 to earn 35. Elbows pinned, neutral grip, full curl to shoulder height, slow 2-second negative. If RPE 8 is where you're landing at 10 reps, the weight is right ? just need the effort to come down a notch as you adapt.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? replacing dumbbell pullover this week. Pullover had two consecutive weeks of incomplete logging ? only 1 of 3 sets tracked the week before, and you got all 3 in last week at 12/12/12 RPE 6/6/6. That's a clean finish, so we're rotating to a different lat isolation movement to keep things fresh. Straight-arm pulldown hits the same lat stretch-and-squeeze pattern but standing at the cable. Bar attachment, arms straight, hinge slightly at the hips, drive the bar down to your thighs using your lats only. Start at 40 lbs ? baseline week. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? legs day was not logged again this week. No log from Friday means we still have no confirmed data since the previous 9/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 session. That's at least two consecutive weeks without a leg day log. The plan was identical last week ? nothing changed because you didn't show up, or you showed up and didn't log it. Either way, fix it this week. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE ? 8 to earn 175. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels. Log it.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 145 ? no legs day log this week. Previous data was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7, which is a clean earn for 155 ? but we can't bump without a confirmed session. Show up, replicate the 10/10/10 at RPE ? 7 this week, and you get 155 the week after. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar tracking close to your shins on the way down, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom. Don't round the lower back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? no legs day log. Previous data had you stuck at 10 reps when the target is 12. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin stays vertical, drive through the front heel. Push past 10 on every set this week ? the reps are in you, you just need to commit to the last two. Log each side separately.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 75 ? no legs day log this week. Previous data was 12/12/10 at RPE 7/7/8 ? first two sets clean, third set dropped. Need 12/12/12 at RPE ? 8 to earn 85. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, hard squeeze for one full second. That third set is the only thing standing between you and a bump. Lock it in.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Staying at 50 ? this was rotated in last week as a baseline exercise but legs day wasn't logged, so we have zero data on it. This week treat it like a first session: pick 50 lbs, hit 12-15 reps at RPE 7, adjust if needed, and log what you actually used. Squeeze hard at the top for one full second, slow controlled negative on the way down. Don't let your hips come off the seat.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.notes: Staying with captain's chair knee raise ? still no data on this one because legs day hasn't been logged. Two weeks in a row without a log on this movement. Forearms on the dip bar pads, raise knees to chest height, no swinging, control the descent all the way down. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7-8. This is bodyweight core work ? there's no excuse to skip the log on this one. Three sets, every rep counted.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
